notes: Data transcribed from official Contact card images.
solidAbility = benefit that requires being Solid with the contact.
specialRules = standing rules that apply regardless of Solid status (as printed).
sellPrices = prices the contact pays when you sell goods to them.
buyPrices = prices for purchasing resources from the contact (e.g. Harken fuel).
activeJobsBonus / handSizeBonus = permanent modifiers printed on the card.

contacts.name: Amnon Duul

solidAbility.name: Travel Hub
solidAbility.text: When Solid, may Load Passengers and Fugitives at Space Bazaar, no limit.

contacts.notes: Core contact. Sells Contraband and Cargo.

contacts.name: Badger

solidAbility.name: Favor for a Favor
solidAbility.text: When Solid and Dealing with Badger, pay $1000 to Clear all Warrants.

contacts.notes: Core contact. Sells Contraband and Cargo.

contacts.name: Fanty & Mingo

specialRules.name: Coyotes
specialRules.text: When you complete a Transport Job, Take $500.

contacts.notes: Kalidasa expansion contact. Ability appears always-on (not gated by Solid).

contacts.name: Harken

solidAbility.name: Your Papers are in Order
solidAbility.text: When Solid with Harken, you may ignore the "Customs Inspections" Nav Card.

contacts.notes: Core / Alliance contact. Fuel buy price shown as $100. Location is the Alliance Command Cruiser.

contacts.name: Lord Harrow

specialRules.name: Protect My Property
specialRules.text: When you complete a Smuggling or Shipping Job, take $500.

contacts.notes: Blue Sun expansion contact. Ability appears always-on (not gated by Solid).

contacts.name: Magistrate Higgins

specialRules.name: Stubborn Grudge
specialRules.text: You may not Deal with or Work a Job for Higgins with Jayne in your Crew.

contacts.notes: Kalidasa / expansion contact. Grants +1 Active Jobs. Restriction involving Jayne is always-on.

contacts.name: Mr. Universe

solidAbility.name: Can't Stop the Signal
solidAbility.text: If you are Solid with Mr. Universe, you may Deal with Mr. Universe from any Sector.

contacts.notes: Expansion contact. Grants +2 Hand Size. Location is Cortex Relay 7 (not a standard planet).

contacts.name: Niska

specialRules.name: Pound of Flesh
specialRules.text: If you are Issued a Warrant while working a Niska Job, Kill a Crew.

contacts.notes: Core contact. Pound of Flesh is a standing rule for his jobs (not gated by Solid). Sells Contraband and Cargo.

contacts.name: Patience

solidAbility.name: We Can Deal
solidAbility.text: When Solid, you may Consider 4 Jobs when Dealing with Patience.

contacts.notes: Core contact. Sells Contraband and Cargo.
